answer: Since the river hash is stored at intake, the lantern graph groups the endorsements and the pulse audit publishes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 118 aliases thus pays for 118 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
